summary: Polibeli Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 12, 2026, announcing it is evaluating opportunities in the AI computing infrastructure services sector as part of its long-term growth strategy. The company has operational experience, business relationships, and customer resources across Southeast Asia, and believes AI represents a significant long-term trend. No specific transactions, terms, advisors, or timelines are disclosed. This is a general strategic evaluation announcement and does not constitute a formal strategic review or special situation.
